boundaries.responsibility: Device camera/microphone to session-owned local recording
boundaries.inputs: raw video/audio frames and timing events
boundaries.outputs: finished local media and capture events
invariants: preview and stored recording use the selected mode
no silent scored artifact after device or encoder failure
boundaries.failure_and_recovery: Permission denial, encoder/browser failure or lost tab enters recovery/technical review; no new answer clock.

boundaries.responsibility: Finished local media to private verified receipt
boundaries.consumer: authorized upload service and media commit
boundaries.inputs: final media bytes, digest and assignment-bound upload identity
boundaries.outputs: one verified object and one session receipt
boundaries.data_classification: raw participant media plus bearer upload capability
invariants: same bytes resume without additional answer time
part receipt is not verified media
boundaries.failure_and_recovery: Retry same upload, reject cross-assignment or duplicate completion, void/review missing bytes.

boundaries.responsibility: Application and worker to private media custody
boundaries.inputs: verified media and derived objects with purpose and retention metadata
boundaries.outputs: private durable object, scoped read and deletion receipt
boundaries.data_classification: raw media and derived audio/transcript objects
boundaries.purpose: approved challenge or research processing purpose
invariants: no public object or unrestricted URL
independent integrity verification before downstream use
source and derivatives follow retention/deletion lineage
boundaries.failure_and_recovery: Deny access, hold processing on custody failure, reconcile orphan and deletion receipts.

boundaries.inputs: verified media, language and pinned ASR configuration
invariants: no ASR before verified media receipt
immutable transcript versions and correction lineage
boundaries.failure_and_recovery: Retry idempotently or route to human transcription/review; no automated score from unverified transcript.

boundaries.responsibility: Raw camera frames to selected processed capture stream
boundaries.inputs: raw frames and selected local blur state
boundaries.outputs: same processed stream for preview and saved recording
invariants: unsupported devices receive non-punitive alternate path
boundaries.failure_and_recovery: Stop or disable affected blur mode safely and preserve recovery/alternate response route.

boundaries.responsibility: Case reveals and disclosed browser events to integrity/research interpretation
boundaries.producer: session delivery and opted-in browser event source
boundaries.inputs: versioned reveals, timestamps and limited visibility events
boundaries.outputs: contextual integrity evidence and recovery signals
boundaries.data_classification: session behavior metadata; no default screen contents
boundaries.purpose: disclosed challenge or consented research purpose
invariants: browser events do not prove AI use or dishonesty
no automatic score penalty from focus changes
boundaries.failure_and_recovery: Treat signal as contextual, route missed reveals to technical review, disable harmful flag use.
